body:
Makes sense to me.

`metadata_properties` was introduced in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/59452. As far as I can tell, it was meant to be an optimization for the `set` and `get` case (not needing a substring).

3 reasons why I I think `metadata_properties` is premature optimization:
1. `starts_with` is not meaningfully slower (probably faster) than hash lookup, in the 'miss' path. Regular property access will not be slower.
2. `set` metadata is likely faster through this change than before (less hash lookups).
3. The fast path to get metadata is `get_meta`. The regular property getter is a convenience method and is overshadowed by the rest of `get` anyway — this won't make a difference.

The only caveat to (1) is that we make an unnecessary `String` copy here, which increments and decrements an atomic. This is unavoidable until https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118856 is merged. I'd prefer if https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118856 was merged first to avoid a lookup regression from this.
